title: Reduced motion and pause controls
description: Respect prefers-reduced-motion and provide a separate pause action for nonessential animation without depending on movement to communicate meaning.
objectives: Write a reduced-motion media query that turns off nonessential animation
Provide a manually usable pause/resume button
Test computed animation names under both motion preferences
Keep essential information visible without animation
rubric: I observed no nonessential animation under reduced-motion emulation.
I paused and resumed motion via a keyboard-operable button.
I confirmed meaning remains available without animated effects.
